description: This source file defines the `OpenClawBonjour` enumeration with related static constants and methods for managing service domain naming conventions for the OpenClaw Bonjour integration. It includes functions to resolve, normalize, and manage service domain strings used within the application.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves the wide area domain string, trimming whitespace and normalizing, returning nil if the domain is empty or matches the internal gateway service domain.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a raw domain string by trimming whitespace, converting to lowercase, and appending a period if necessary; defaults to the internal gateway service domain for empty or special cases.
